'''Harken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Harken appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of an achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
